canonical_product_owner: Animal Rosetta Stone — Presentation & Research Workbench Architecture v1.0
purpose: Implement the architecture-defined Decipherment Workspace and Experiment & Analysis Workspace as read-only presentation over existing canonical Workbench services.

allowed: dataset, population/group and split filtering through existing events.list
pagination through existing bounded offset/limit service behavior
selection of two to four source-preserved events for side-by-side alignment
presentation-only URL state for filters, pagination and selected event IDs
event to dataset and provenance navigation
registered metrics, dispositions, gates and interpretation ceilings
visible missing state for absent protocol, split, controls, environment or reproducibility fields
forbidden: synthetic verification presented as empirical evidence

cross_navigation_rule: Only canonical identifiers or deterministic identifier joins may establish navigation relationships.
localization_rule: Only interface chrome is localized; canonical scientific records remain verbatim.
